digest.component_or_area: structured-output orchestration seam replacement from Rebar custom implementation to Pydantic AI native
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 native output, prompted output, retry, usage limits, and fallback seams must preserve Rebar's deterministic repair, schema extraction, three-attempt ceiling, stop-reason fast-fail, provider policy, and failure taxonomy without accidental behavioral deltas
Successful output retry must aggregate complete operation usage into single in-memory result and durable JSONL row, not accepted-attempt-only usage
Failed response retry must send complete response only when deterministic fit is proven, otherwise omit it whole; never prefix-truncate or mutate stored history
Output-size rejection must consume bounded retry allowance with concise-response guidance and remain terminal; request_limit must be shared operation-wide across tool turns and output attempts
Retry exhaustion must re-raise exact Rebar-owned StructuredOutputError found in Pydantic cause chain, never blanket-translate UnexpectedModelBehavior

Fallback and native-to-prompted candidates must remain bounded through explicit chain and predicate; candidate-attempt observability must use trace/journal events, not fabricated failed-attempt token usage
